title: Regularity of branched stable minimal immersed hypersurfaces
summary: We establish a sharp bound on the Hausdorff dimension of the non-branch singular set of branched stable minimal immersed hypersurfaces whose singular sets have locally finite $\mathcal H^{n-2}$-measure: the non-branch singular set is empty when $n=2$, discrete when $n=3$, and has Hausdorff dimension at most $n-3$ when $n\geq4$. We also construct a non-flat stable minimal cone in $\mathbb R^4$ arising from a branched minimal immersion whose vertex is a non-branch singularity.
